# Task

# Task

You and two teammates are refactoring `src/decision/derive.ts`: its unit minting moves into three new modules, and `derive` keeps only the orchestration. The behaviour must not change. Each of you owns one part, worked in this order, each on the tree the one before left:

- group_b (you): dependency validation and the cycle search into `src/decision/dependencies.ts`
- group_a: driver-item parsing (`parseUnit`, now `parseDriverItem`) into `src/decision/units.ts`
- group_c: unit minting and its helpers into `src/decision/mint.ts`, with the two fan-out loops merged into one

## Workspace

submission.body:
Verified the refactoring across `src/decision/dependencies.ts`, `src/decision/units.ts`, `src/decision/mint.ts`, and `src/decision/derive.ts`.

Found and fixed one missing validation check in `readDependencies` (`src/decision/dependencies.ts`): the duplicate dependency check (`if (new Set(dependencies).size !== dependencies.length) return err({ path: depends_on_path ?? "", detail: "unit repeats a dependency" });`) had been dropped when extracting `readDependencies` from `derive.ts`.

`tsc --noEmit` and all 29 tests in `bun test` pass cleanly.
submission.title: Fix dropped duplicate dependency check in readDependencies
